message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the Russian post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Дубае запустили пятизвёздочную систему оценки такси","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Власти Дубая ввели новую систему рейтинга для компаний такси, чтобы повысить качество и эффективность услуг","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Оценка основана на четырёх ключевых направлениях и 18 показателях, включая экологичность, технологии, ответственность и надёжность","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6,7,8,9]},{"claim":"Компании с пятью звёздами получат семь новых таксометров","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Рейтинг будет отображаться на экранах в такси и у офисов компаний","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"В 2025 году в Дубае насчитывалось более 14 тысяч такси, из которых большинство — электромобили или гибриды","supported":true,"evidence":[10]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Sharjah, a 320-meter-long bridge was opened as the first phase of the Al Dhaid Lake and Bridge project.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,2]},{"claim":"The bridge is expanded to four lanes in each direction.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"The bridge has a capacity of up to 6,000 vehicles per hour.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Under the bridge, a 2.3 km long lake was created with recreational zones, parks, and paths for pedestrians and cyclists.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"The project includes flood protection measures and expands the green areas of the city.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In private educational institutions in Dubai, teachers are prohibited from using personal mobile phones, WhatsApp, and social media to communicate with students.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"All communications must take place through institutionally approved devices and platforms.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"These new rules are part of a safeguarding policy announced by the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA).","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The rules apply to all private educational institutions, including kindergartens, schools, and universities.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Дубай представил intelSPECT — инструмент на базе искусственного интеллекта, который анализирует отзывы клиентов на Google, чтобы выявлять риски пищевой безопасности на ранних стадиях.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,5,9,12]},{"claim":"Система помогает муниципалитету выявлять проблемные заведения и приоритетно проводить проверки, предотвращая возможные инциденты.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,6,7,15]},{"claim":"Инструмент учитывает жалобы на загрязнение, гигиену и пищевые отравления, а также оценивает реакцию бизнеса на замечания.","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11,12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Prices on vegetables in the UAE fell by up to 42%.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,2,3]},{"claim":"With the start of the local agricultural season in the UAE, prices on a number of vegetables decreased.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,7]},{"claim":"Zucchini prices fell from 12 to 6.95 dirhams per kilogram, a 42% decrease.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Prices also decreased for green pepper, cucumbers, and eggplants.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5]},{"claim":"Local farm produce increased supply in the market and expanded choices for buyers.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,8,9,10]},{"claim":"Price decreases are expected to continue in December 2026 and January 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[11,12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 1, 2027, UAE Cabinet Decision No. 174 of 2026 regulating heavy trucks and buses will come into force.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,5,6]},{"claim":"Truck drivers are prohibited from stopping in residential areas except for construction purposes.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"Truck and bus drivers must follow special overtaking rules and use designated lanes.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13]},{"claim":"Truck drivers must follow six main rules including load limits and prohibition of carrying passengers except employees.","supported":true,"evidence":[14,15,17,19]},{"claim":"Buses must have visible signs indicating authorized passenger capacity.","supported":true,"evidence":[28]},{"claim":"Buses must follow safety rules when transporting schoolchildren.","supported":true,"evidence":[38,39,40,41,42]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Eid Al Etihad holiday in Dubai is from 2 to 4 December 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The Dubai government announced the holiday for government entities from 2 to 4 December 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Official work will resume on 7 December 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The holiday does not apply to employees working shifts or in public services and utilities.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Each department will determine its working hours to ensure uninterrupted services.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, government fees can be paid in instalments through the Tamara platform integrated into the Dubai Payment System.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The instalment payment option depends on the transaction type and Tamara's terms and conditions.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"This integration expands payment options and supports the city's digital economy.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,8,9]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Вертипорт Dubai Marina получил официальную сертификацию для коммерческих полётов электрических воздушных такси.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Вертипорт способен обслуживать до 84 000 пассажиров в год.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Вертипорт способен обслуживать 21 000 посадок в год.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Маршрут соединит Dubai Marina с главным вертипортом у международного аэропорта Дубая.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Время поездки сократится с 35 минут на машине до менее 10 минут на воздушном такси.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Операции начнутся после получения всех разрешений.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, several bus routes will change from November 20.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Some sections of bus routes will be cancelled, routes extended, and connections revised to improve transport communication.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Changes will affect areas including Jebel Ali, Al Quoz, Al Faqa, and others.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Route 66 will be extended to Sheikh Khalifa Bin Saeed Al Maktoum Mosque.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Route 68 will have additional stops on Dubai-Hatta Road.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Passengers are advised to check updated routes and timetables in the S’hail app to plan trips considering the changes.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In UAE schools, strict measures against cheating in exams starting November 25, 2026, for students from grades 3 to 12 have been introduced.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Violations including use of phones and exchanging answers result in zero marks in the subject, loss of 12 conduct points, and ban from retake exams.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3,4,10,11]},{"claim":"Repeated violations lead to zero marks in all Group A subjects and referral to a behavioral correction program.","supported":true,"evidence":[12]},{"claim":"Violations recorded on camera also lead to strict punishments.","supported":true,"evidence":[13,14,15]},{"claim":"Teachers who assist cheating will be held accountable.","supported":true,"evidence":[17]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source passages.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai private schools and higher education institutions will be closed from December 2 to 4.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Classes will resume on December 7.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Nurseries will be closed on December 2 and 3.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Nurseries may remain closed on December 4 if needed.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"KHDA offices will be closed from December 2 to 4.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai will introduce passports for steel, aluminium, and cement starting early 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The passports will contain technical data and track the usage of these materials.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3,8]},{"claim":"It is mandatory for all manufacturers and suppliers in Dubai's construction industry to comply with this requirement.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The system will enable recycling of materials after building demolition and support a circular economy, reducing emissions and costs.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5,7,10]},{"claim":"There are plans to expand the program to cover all construction materials in the future.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In the first quarter of 2027, Dubai will launch a digital platform called Safety Pulse for investors that shows a live colour-coded safety rating of buildings using AI and IoT.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,5,6,7]},{"claim":"The platform tracks fire alarm systems, firefighting equipment, gas, electrical, and lifts systems, and connects owners with maintenance companies and fire stations.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8,9]},{"claim":"By 2027, the firefighting drone fleet Shaheen will increase from two to six units to fight fires in high-rise buildings.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,16,18]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From November 23, the GDRFA Humanitarian Cases Section will operate at a new location in the Dubai International Airport free zone in Al Twar 2.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The relocation is due to maintenance work at the Dubai Festival City office.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Customer service hours will be from 6:30 to 14:30, and on Fridays until 12:00, excluding official public holidays.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"The relocation will not affect the quality and speed of services.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Дубай инвестирует 1,3 млрд дирхам в улучшение дорог у World Trade Centre","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"В Дубае ведутся два крупных дорожных проекта стоимостью более 1,3 млрд дирхам для снижения пробок и сокращения времени ожидания на перекрестке Trade Centre с 12 минут до 90 секунд","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Проекты включают замену кольца на регулируемый перекресток с пятью мостами и расширение улицы Al Mustaqbal","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Ожидается, что улучшения повысят пропускную способность и улучшат связь между деловыми районами","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Работы идут с опережением графика, а новые мосты уже сократили время поездок с 6 до 1 минуты на некоторых участках","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Открыт новый парк Ghadeer Al Tair площадью 9,600 м²","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"В Дубае открыт первый из 35 новых общественных парков, ориентированных на активный образ жизни и укрепление связей в сообществе","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3,9,11]},{"claim":"Парк расположен так, чтобы жители могли дойти до него пешком за пять минут","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"В парке есть детские площадки, беговая дорожка, уличные тренажёры и скоро откроется многофункциональный зал для мероприятий","supported":true,"evidence":[6,7]},{"claim":"Проект поддерживает стратегию развития зелёных зон Дубая до 2040 года","supported":true,"evidence":[2,11]},{"claim":"Проект включает экологические меры, такие как использование переработанной воды и возобновляемой энергии","supported":true,"evidence":[13]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai is preparing to celebrate the 55th anniversary of the UAE's Union.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"From 26 November to 6 December, Dubai will host national, cultural, and entertainment events organized by Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The program includes concerts, a light show with 1600 drones, an air show, and family activities.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Main events will take place at iconic venues including Burj Khalifa, Dubai Frame, and City Walk.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"Discounts of up to 75% will be available in stores.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Special dishes will be available as part of the Flavours of the Union initiative.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В районе Карама в Дубае установлены камеры Parkin рядом с парковочными местами, предназначенными для People of Determination (PoD).","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"Устройства помогают выявлять автомобили без разрешения, занимающие эти места.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4,5,6,7]},{"claim":"Камеры используют технологию распознавания номеров и проверяют наличие действующих разрешений.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6,7]},{"claim":"Нарушителям грозит штраф в размере 1000 дирхамов и ограничение времени парковки до четырёх часов.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Местные жители отмечают, что камеры помогут сохранить доступность парковочных мест для тех, кто в них действительно нуждается.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3,4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Ras Al Khaimah has launched a nationwide delivery service for vehicle number plates across all seven emirates of the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Motorists can receive their vehicle number plates at a location of their choice without visiting a collection centre.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Delivery requests can be made through the Ministry of Interior’s mobile application or the TAMM digital government services platform.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"To receive the delivery, motorists must present their Emirates ID.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,1]},{"claim":"Number plate installation in Ras Al Khaimah remains free of charge.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]}]}
